titre: Le marché mondial des serveurs change d'échelle
sous_titre: Chiffre d'affaires trimestriel des fabricants, en Mds de dollars, du 3e trimestre 2025 au 2e trimestre 2026

T3 2025.texte: Total worldwide revenue climbed to $112.4 billion for the quarter, marking a 61% increase compared with the same period last year.

T4 2025.texte: surpassing the previous high of $125.3 billion set in the fourth quarter of 2025

T1 2026.texte: The Q1 server market was up 30.4% YoY at $122.6 billion, according to IDC's Worldwide Quarterly Server Tracker.

T2 2026.texte: The worldwide server market reached a record $166.3 billion in vendor revenue in the second quarter of 2026
